question: How hot does this MOSFET get switching 15 A at 20 kHz in a 50 C box?
headline: Junction reaches about 110 C (1.51 W: 1.37 W conduction, 0.144 W switching) with 40 C/W to 50 C air; limit 150 C.

checks.name: hand calculation
checks.summary: conduction loss I_rms^2 R = 0.903 W; ngspice average of V x I = 0.903 W (0.00079% apart)

checks.name: thermal loop
checks.summary: junction settles at 110 C after the on resistance warms up (12.1 mohm hot)

assumptions: On resistance 8 mohm at 25 C rising 0.6% per C.
Switching loss from 40 ns edges: 0.5 V I (tr + tf) f.
Junction to air 40 C/W (datasheet, no heatsink unless included).
